Chapter 296: Chapter 6 Lucky Break (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 296: Chapter 6 Lucky Break (Please Subscribe)

The strength of the clans in the Main World is divided into Peak Clans, Powerful Clans, Ordinary Clans, and Weak Clans.

At the head of the Insect Race Alliance, a Peak Clan, are

hundreds of powerful clans, as well as tens of thousands of ordinary clans,

united to counter the expansion of human civilization and to compete for their interests.

Apart from the Insect Race Alliance, there are six or seven similar clan alliances, all centered around a particular Peak Clan.

Of course.

...

Since human civilization has also absorbed many different species, it is also known as the Human Civilization Alliance.

“Battlefield C24763, significant spatial fluctuations detected, and a permanent spatial rift from a million years ago, created by a high-rank evolver with a supreme weapon…”

All the various information about this alien battlefield was clearly understood by Lin Yuan.

In the Immortal Tao World, the reason Lin Yuan dared not send his Yang God and Yin God to the Spirit Realm was his unfamiliarity with it.

This meant overwhelming risk, and with the coordinates of the Spirit Realm in hand, Lin Yuan did not need to take this kind of risk.

Other cultivators, demon practitioners, were desperate to ascend to the Spirit Realm, no matter the cost.

That’s because they had no other choice.

But Lin Yuan was different.

He had many options.

Even without the coordinates of the Spirit Realm, Lin Yuan had almost infinite choices.

“This battlefield will do…”

Lin Yuan made up his mind.

Even with wormhole travel, it would take half a month to get from Chikun Star to Battlefield C24763.

So, Lin Yuan needed to hurry.

“Goddess of Wisdom, I want to apply to go to Battlefield C24763.”

Lin Yuan connected with the Goddess of Wisdom and voiced his request.

“Respected Level 6 Citizen Lin Yuan, with your status, there is no need for you to fight on the alien battlefields…”

The solemn and cold voice of the Goddess of Wisdom came through, surprisingly beginning to dissuade Lin Yuan.

This was much like the Chikun Star Lord, also not recommending Lin Yuan go to the alien battlefields or, if he must, to send an avatar rather than go in person.

“Don’t worry, I won’t be going in person.”

Lin Yuan explained.

“Respected Level 6 Citizen Lin Yuan, you may now state your demands…”

Suddenly, a voice as cold as ice, laced with a hint of killing intent, rang out. It was entirely different from the solemnity and coldness of the Goddess of Wisdom.

“It’s the Goddess of Freedom.”

A notion flickered in Lin Yuan’s mind.

The Cosmic Alliance of Human Civilizations is governed by three ultimate A.I. goddesses.

They are the Goddess of Wisdom, the Goddess of Freedom, and the Goddess of Justice.

The domains overseen by the three goddesses vary; the Goddess of Wisdom is in charge of civil affairs and is the one Lin Yuan interacts with the most.

Whereas the Goddess of Freedom is responsible for war and conquest.

Simply put, the more than two million alien battlefields that the Human Civilization Alliance has established are all managed and dispatched by the Goddess of Freedom.

As Lin Yuan wanted to go to an alien battlefield, any subsequent matters naturally required connecting with the Goddess of Freedom.

“Hide my identity, don’t follow a team, act alone…”

With Lin Yuan’s status as Peak Master Thirteen of the Red Kun Lineage, if he were to go to an alien battlefield with this identity.

It is likely that what was originally a minor alien battlefield would attract a large number of Seventh Rank and Eighth Rank alien strong ones.

As for following a team…the power of an individual evolver is very insignificant on an alien battlefield, and they would need the combined efforts of several evolvers of the same rank to hope to kill alien strong ones and earn Merit Points.

This is why most evolvers on the battlefield choose to form groups into teams.

But Lin Yuan did not need to.

He had no intention of fighting to the death with the alien strong ones.

“Respected Level 6 Citizen Lin Yuan, your application has been approved, and the Battlefield Pass has been updated.”

The cold and murderous voice of the Goddess of Freedom came through.

The Battlefield Pass is an important document that signifies Lin Yuan’s identity within the Human Alliance ranks, allowing him entry and exit from the human-controlled territories on the battlefield.

Without the Battlefield Pass, on an alien battlefield, you are akin to a person without any status, fair game for both the human race and different species to attack.

…

“Everything’s almost ready.”

With a thought from Lin Yuan, a hundreds of meters large spaceship appeared before him.

The warship, jet black and streamlined, was imbued with a certain high-tech aura.

The expanse of the cosmic frontiers was vast, like traveling from Chikun Main Star to Battlefield C24763 at the speed of light, which would take a very long time.

So normal human evolvers travel on warships for long-distance wormhole shuttle.

But wormhole shuttle needs a cooling-off period.

Without paying a price, consecutive shuttling is not possible.

Whirling.

A phantom figure walked out from Lin Yuan’s body.

When it appeared in the outside world, it quickly condensed into substance.

It was Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit.

“Go.”

Lin Yuan looked at the Taiyang Divine Spirit.

With a smile at the corners of his mouth, the Taiyang Divine Spirit entered the spaceship.

Suddenly.

The spaceship began to activate.

Heading out beyond Chikun Main Star.

As the most prosperous planet within a Star Domain,

there are countless spaceships and warships coming and going from Chikun Main Star every day.

The spaceship that Lin Yuanyang was on did not attract much attention.

Whoosh.

The pitch-black spaceship swiftly entered the Star Platform of Chikun Main Star, preparing to leave.

…

“I hope the experience on the alien battlefield will help me grasp the Space Rules.”

Lin Yuan secretly thought.

By sending the Yang Spirit to the alien battlefield, Lin Yuan was not only eager to thoroughly understand the 965 kinds of space models.

But he also intended to expedite understanding the subsequent 7,782 kinds of space models.

…

“Why is there extra money in my account?”

Lin Yuan returned to the grand hall, glanced casually at his account balance, and discovered an additional several billion Civilization Coins.
